# Understanding Ladder

Explain anything at the easiest format that still fully answers, following Karpathy's understanding ladder: classify the content, then produce (1) plain controlled text, (2) a diagram, (3) an interactive single-file HTML page, or (4) an explainer-video storyboard — always from a checkable plain-text draft, with nothing cut and a "What to check" list at the end. Works in English and Chinese.
